changelog: Update packages are now verified against the published SHA-256 checksum before install
MCP security validator: case/slash-insensitive path checks (c:/ and C:/ no longer bypass the root-path block), bounded validation history
MCP manager: external servers (Claude/Codex sources) survive config reloads; hard-timeout capping is now logged
Fixed duplicate delete_session in session history (error handling restored)
Switching providers in the CLI now resets the API base URL (no more localhost:1234 leaking into Anthropic)
OpenAI reasoning models (o-series, GPT-5) get max_completion_tokens and no temperature instead of rejected params
Refreshed builtin model catalogs (Claude Sonnet/Opus 5, GPT-5/4.1, stable Gemini 2.5 IDs) and CLI provider defaults
Subagent turn limits are now enforced by the loop, not just suggested in the prompt
Removed leftover [LOOP DEBUG] stderr prints from the approval path
Added GitHub Actions CI (ruff, mypy, pytest, version consistency check)
Version single-sourced from update.json across plugin.json, ida-plugin.json, CLI and Dockerfile
Fixed Docker skills volume mount path; removed obsolete compose keys and dead blocks
Added tests/conftest.py plus targeted tests for updater checksum, MCP security normalization, and manager reload
